results.question: 每个区域清运量最大的那辆车分别是谁
results.sql:
WITH vehicle_weight AS (
  SELECT r.region_name, v.plate_number, SUM(rm.total_weight) AS total_weight
  FROM t_route_manifest rm
  JOIN t_vehicle v ON rm.vehicle_id = v.id
  JOIN t_region r ON rm.region_id = r.id
  GROUP BY r.region_name, v.plate_number
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT region_name, plate_number, total_weight,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region_name ORDER BY total_weight DESC) AS rn
  FROM vehicle_weight
)
SELECT region_name, plate_number, total_weight
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY total_weight DESC
LIMIT 1000

results.question: 这个月既有超速预警、清运量又排前 5 的车
results.sql:
WITH monthly_weight AS (
  SELECT rm.vehicle_id,
         SUM(rm.total_weight) AS total_weight,
         SUM(rm.total_trips) AS total_trips
  FROM t_route_manifest rm
  WHERE rm.route_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)
  GROUP BY rm.vehicle_id
),
overspeed AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.vehicle_id
  FROM t_alert a
  WHERE a.alert_time >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)
    AND a.alert_type ILIKE '%超速%'
)
SELECT v.plate_number,
       r.region_name,
       mw.total_weight,
       mw.total_trips
FROM monthly_weight mw
JOIN overspeed o ON o.vehicle_id = mw.vehicle_id
JOIN t_vehicle v ON v.id = mw.vehicle_id
LEFT JOIN t_region r ON r.id = v.region_id
ORDER BY mw.total_weight DESC
LIMIT 5
